name: decision-pack
title: Request decision record
for_each: select id,title as name from requests

sections.title: Approval steps
sections.sql: select position,name,assignee,state,due_at,decided_by,evidence,note,decided_at from tasks where request_id=$1 order by position

sections.title: History
sections.sql: select actor,action,detail,created_at from activity where request_id=$1 order by created_at,id

sections.title: Purpose and owner
sections.sql: select name,owner,purpose,review_due,published from workflows where id=$1

sections.title: Approval rules
sections.sql: select position,name,assignee,due_days from step_definitions where workflow_id=$1 order by position

sections.title: Open and imported requests
sections.sql: select title,requester,state,source_status from requests where workflow_id=$1 and state in ('draft','active','imported') order by title
